lines: Next product: Docs2Video. This one is easy to love and easy to sell.
Docs2Video turns any document into a branded, narrated explainer video in minutes.
A business uploads a P.D.F., and out comes a polished video with a voice, visuals, and their brand.
No cameras, no editing, no film crew. Just upload, and the A.I. does the rest.
It comes in four tiers, from a starter plan to enterprise, so it fits any size business.
Who needs it? Insurance agents, real estate, any business that explains things to clients.
Your pitch: turn boring paperwork into videos clients actually watch. That's the hook.
Like SmartViewz, it's a monthly subscription — recurring income on every account you open.
Show a prospect one sample video, and it often sells itself.
That's Docs2Video. Now, a brand-new addition to the family — Jordyn. Let's go.
